opening.argument: The presentation centers compensation on a two-sided recruitment structure, stating that viewers can earn 10 percent of the volume on their "lesser leg" or "lesser team." It extends that promise beyond direct referrals, explaining that the qualifying activity may come from "somebody that you didn't even personally know or refer" as far as 100 levels down. The presentation also promotes purchased Tycoon packages through projected token value, stating that 48,000 coins at fifty cents would be worth 24,000 euros. Alongside those financial incentives, the speaker directly urges viewers to "position yourself for success and partner with our team today." The displayed earnings and disclaimer do not remove the central pitch: join the team, purchase packages, and seek commissions from activity throughout the recruited structure.
